quarterly_data.quarter: Power Integrations press release: Power Integrations Unveils 4th Generation of Pioneering (09-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Launched the CAPZero-4 X-capacitor discharge IC family for industrial and consumer AC-DC supplies (appliance, display, adapter, industrial): reduces system no-load and standby input power by up to 1000 mW, device consumption below 0.75 mW at 230 VAC, -40 to 125 deg. C operation, pin- and package-compatible with CAPZero-3. CAPZero-4 is in production and shipping to customers; more than one billion CAPZero ICs shipped since 2010.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 1000 mW standby reduction; below 0.75 mW at 230 VAC; in production and shipping; more than one billion CAPZero ICs shipped since 2010
